notes: All quotes come from the Parcoursup fiche for this programme (portail Economie gestion at Université de Rennes). Parcoursup is the route for French/European Bac holders; a Moroccan Bac holder applies via Études en France / Campus France (see https://www.maroc.campusfrance.org/candidature-en-1ere-annee-de-licence-a-l-universite-et-en-paces), so no applicationChannel is given here. Tuition: the fiche states 'Par année 178 euros' and 'Pas de frais pour les boursiers'; 178 EUR is the reduced French/EU rate, and the excerpt mentioning 'étudiant extra communautaire' with '2 902 euros pour une année en cycle de Licence' comes from a Campus France Maroc page about French public higher education in general and is not a figure specific to this programme, so no tuition fact is extracted.
